svg.title: Разведение гантелей в стороны с наклоном корпуса — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. STANDING BENT-FORWARD DUMBBELL LATERAL/REAR RAISE. Both figures stand with knees softly bent, hips hinged back and torso leaned forward about 45 degrees, neutral back, no bench, no chair. Left: arms hang down from shoulders under chest, each hand holding a dumbbell. Right: both arms abduct out to sides until aligned with shoulders, slight elbow bend. Maintain same forward torso incline and stable feet. Rear three-quarter view to reveal both arms and hip hinge. Not an upright seated lateral raise. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
